mission: Bring in the strongest local agent roles plus source-backed fitness app and GitHub fitness-agent inputs to drive TransformFitAI code review, refactoring, agent testing, and UI testing.

truth_status.reason: This artifact records local agent-role assignment, public GitHub/App Store benchmark research, and deterministic review tasks. It does not claim human outreach, endorsement, production execution of third-party repositories, or live App Store / Play Store user testing.

usable_lessons: Use a 20-role swarm spanning Flutter, mobile, backend/auth, security, model QA, privacy, behavioral science, UI/UX, accessibility, performance, workflow, and verification.
Create custom domain agents for release parity, wearable data integrity, strength programming, nutrition/body-composition safety, and AI health coach safety.
sidecar_inputs.caveat: Sidecar produced role guidance only; no external outreach, execution, push, deploy, or dependency adoption occurred.

usable_lessons: Current widget/unit coverage is strong, but integration_test, Patrol, golden screenshot, and real-device Apple/Android interaction harnesses are missing.
TestSprite critical-flow routes drifted from the actual router and must be contract-checked.
sidecar_inputs.caveat: Sidecar was read-only; it did not execute real-device tests or cloud TestSprite runs.

usable_lessons: Wearable adapter wiring, active-session coach branching, onboarding seed handling, sanitizer parity, stale week anchoring, and fabricated debrief data are current high-value review targets.
Direct adapter tests and route/state parity tests should precede deeper refactors.
sidecar_inputs.caveat: Sidecar was read-only; findings are not fixed until a later implementation slice proves them.
Subagent exceeded context. Public benchmark research was completed locally and source-backed in top_app_build_benchmarks.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: recordingMethodsToFilter likely filters out automatically recorded recovery data instead of manual data only.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Remove or configure the filter and add adapter tests with automatic-only points.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Real wearable sync adapter exists but is not wired into app state; Today injects local sample data.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Introduce a provider/use-case around HealthWearableAdapter and test adapter output reaching session state.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Live-session coaching can fall back to post-session progress logic whenever history exists.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Add an active-session branch before history/progress and test activeSession plus history.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Onboarding handoff fabricates soreness data from long-term limitations or first-session seed.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Separate first-session seed from real soreness input and test that limitations do not become soreness.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Client and server sanitizers drift; server strips question marks while client does not.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Share sanitizer logic or add parity tests for question-mark phrases.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Pending intake and why-now providers are write-only and never cleared after plan reveal or handoff.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Clear after successful handoff and test second-visit freshness.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Current week is anchored to latest completed session instead of wall-clock current date.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Inject now into summary builder and test history older than seven days.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Adherence context repeats stale anchoring to latest completed session.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Use the same wall-clock helper as progress and add old-history tests.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Wearable sync can report synced when no usable data points exist.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Add connected_no_data or unavailable sync state and test empty point results.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Final onboarding CTA blocks local workout entry on remote profile completion.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Seed local session first, navigate, then reconcile auth/profile asynchronously.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Remote plan parsing defaults missing ids, names, and days instead of rejecting malformed payloads.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Validate required fields and fall back on malformed function responses.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Recovery-session classification is duplicated across coach, progress, composition, and proof code.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Extract one shared classifier before logic diverges.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Emotional-map UI is duplicated in coach command and progress screens.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Extract a shared widget to avoid semantic and copy drift.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Obsolete M1 onboarding surface can bypass the current landing/intake/plan/handoff contract if routed again.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Remove/archive it or hard-gate it behind dev-only routing.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Workout debrief stores canned satisfaction and notes instead of real user detail.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Collect those fields or omit them and test only entered fields persist.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: attachActiveSessionPlan cannot clear stale in-session plans because it ignores empty lists.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Allow explicit clear and add controller regression coverage.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Volume metrics exclude bodyweight/timed work and skew progress/proof summaries for recovery users.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Introduce a separate effort/work metric.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Plan reveal reads intake and phrase once, so mounted screens do not recompute if providers reseed.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Encode immutability explicitly or switch to watch/invalidate with a mounted-refresh test.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Offline snapshot recovery deletes unreadable snapshots immediately with no migration path.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Add versioned migrations or backup/telemetry before purge.

code_review_findings_top20.issue: Today screen carries readiness hydration, logging, recovery shortcuts, nutrition, wearable samples, and auth sign-out.
code_review_findings_top20.next_action: Split into smaller widgets/controllers after adding targeted tests.

Real recruited user testing and live TestSprite cloud runs remain incomplete.
